name: ScrollIndicator
description: Animated affordance at the base of a hero that scrolls to the next section.

keyboard: Enter: scrolls to the target section
Space: scrolls to the target section
ariaRequirements: Renders a real <button>, so it is focusable and activates on Enter and Space
aria-label or a visible label names the destination when no text is shown

governance.note: Promoted out of the bespoke/infrastructure exemption: consumed by ProjectHero, BlogHero and AboutHero, which is reusable-primitive usage rather than app infrastructure. Alpha because forced-colors and light/dark have not been verified; beta needs both plus a11y review.

content.voice: A short imperative naming the destination, not the gesture.

terminology.rationale: Names where the user lands. The gesture is already implied by the affordance and is wrong for keyboard and AT users.

content.notes: The label is optional. When omitted the control still needs an accessible name naming the destination.

targetId.description: ID of the target element to scroll to

motion.description: Looping motion applied to the icon as a hint to scroll.

speed.description: Duration of one motion half-cycle, in seconds.

distance.description: Vertical travel of the bounce motion, in pixels (bounce only).

forbiddenUse: (must): render it as a `<div>` with a click handler -- it must stay a real button so it is reachable by Tab and activates on both Enter and Space.
use it as general in-page navigation. It communicates "there is more below", not "jump to section". Use a link or `Breadcrumb` for navigation.
stack more than one on a page. Two scroll cues in one viewport contradict each other about where the reader should go next.
rely on the animation to carry meaning. It is suppressed under reduced motion, so the label and accessible name must stand alone.
